extract_netcdf()
Extract values from one or more netCDF files This is the general extraction interface. The user chooses the type of extraction with the method argument. The more specific functions extract2d(), extract3d_surface(), extract3d_bottom(), extract3d_nearest() and extract3d_all() are wrappers around this function.
